title: Appliance
description: A switchable appliance (washer, dryer). Starting it raises the home's live power draw by its wattage and its monthly usage by its per-cycle energy; stopping it lowers the power draw again. Both are cross-Thing effects, and are idempotent so a repeated start or stop does not double-count.

startAppliance.title: Start
startAppliance.vre:effects: const home = <home>; home.currentPowerUsageW' = home.currentPowerUsageW + (isRunning ? 0 : powerWatts); home.currentMonthUsageKWh' = home.currentMonthUsageKWh + (isRunning ? 0 : kwhPerCycle); isRunning' = true; output.success = true; output.isRunning = isRunning'; output.message = "Started with " + cycle + " cycle";

stopAppliance.title: Stop
stopAppliance.vre:effects: const home = <home>; home.currentPowerUsageW' = home.currentPowerUsageW - (isRunning ? powerWatts : 0); isRunning' = false; output.success = true; output.isRunning = isRunning';
